newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends soft at 483.75/484.75/dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends soft at 483.75/484.75/dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed soft at 483.75/484.75 per dollar as the Central Bank stood back from supplying dollars into a session marked by high corporate dollar demand, traders said.
On Wednesday the bolivar closed at 483.25/484.25 per dollar.
"The reason the exchange rate weakened is because the Central Bank allowed it to ... and there was strong demand by companies for dollars," said one trader.

Venezuela's foreign exchange market is unusual in that the Central Bank is its largest single supplier of dollars, which blurs the difference between the Central Bank supplying liquidity and intervening.
